Identify skill gaps and build structured training and certification pathways aligned to ECI’s service portfolio. Manage performance formally and informally; address issues directly, constructively, and on record when required. Participate in hiring decisions for the implementation function, including technical assessments and structured panel interviews. Project Delivery & Program Management Own end-to-end delivery of network implementation projects spanning new client onboarding, infrastructure refreshes, office builds, and technology migrations. Strong working knowledge of routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP), VLANs, QoS, and IPv4/IPv6 fundamentals. Solid understanding of security frameworks, compliance standards, and change management governance in regulated client environments.
